ink.note: Full slate ramp. Light mode reads this ramp light-to-dark (paper -> ink); dark mode reads it dark-to-light (per The Mirror Rule in DESIGN.md).

display.purpose: Screen titles and the wordmark. Never used for numerals.

numeral.purpose: The one number or word per screen that carries a decision or commitment.

label.purpose: 9-10px bold uppercase wide-tracked micro-caption used everywhere instead of visible section chrome.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default for every card, list container, and chart panel (shadow-sm).

shadows.name: commitment
shadows.purpose: Primary CTAs, the app shell, and modal sheets (shadow-xl/2xl).

shadows.name: commitment-tinted
shadows.purpose: Same escalation as commitment, but under brand-blue elements (sign-in button, hero icon badge) for a soft blue glow instead of neutral black.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every tappable primary/icon control compresses slightly on press.

motion.name: sheet-spring
motion.purpose: Bottom-sheet modals (Log Weight) slide up with physical spring motion, not an ease curve.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width primary call to action (e.g. Save Entry). Black-weight label, press-scale feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand-500, #1e40af); color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 18px; padding: 20px 24px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(30,64,175,0.15); transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-600, #1e3a8a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand-500, #1e40af); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Toggleable context tag (e.g. 'High Sodium') shown in the Log Weight sheet. Selected and unselected states shown together.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: none; background: var(--theme-surface-active, #f1f5f9); color: var(--theme-text-secondary, #64748b); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--theme-surface-hover, #f8fafc); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-chip--selected { background: var(--color-brand-500, #1e40af); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(30,64,175,0.2); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Dashboard metric tile: eyebrow label, large bold value, muted unit, optional trend subvalue.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: var(--theme-surface, #fff); padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--theme-line, #e2e8f0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-stat-card__label { color: var(--theme-text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-stat-card__value-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; } .ds-stat-card__value { color: var(--theme-ink, #0f172a); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; } .ds-stat-card__unit { color: var(--theme-text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-stat-card__sub { color: var(--theme-text-secondary, #64748b); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-top: 16px; }

components.name: Floating Nav Action
components.description: The bottom tab bar's centered '+' floating action button, breaking the bar's top edge.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-fab" aria-label="Log weight"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-nav-fab { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-brand-500, #1e40af); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 4px solid var(--theme-paper, #f8fafc); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); margin-top: -40px; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-nav-fab:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Small rounded state badge (health-sync connected/warning/neutral), icon + eyebrow-style label.
components.html: Connected
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-status-pill--success { background: var(--theme-emerald-50, #ecfdf5); color: #047857; } .ds-status-pill--warning { background: var(--theme-amber-50, #fffbeb); color: var(--theme-amber-900, #78350f); } .ds-status-pill--neutral { background: var(--theme-surface-active, #f1f5f9); color: var(--theme-text-secondary, #64748b); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Boolean setting control (e.g. Dark Mode). The system's only form of checkbox.
components.css: .ds-toggle { width: 48px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; position: relative; background: var(--theme-line, #e2e8f0); transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-toggle--on { background: var(--color-brand-500, #1e40af); } .ds-toggle__thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; transition: left 0.2s; } .ds-toggle--on .ds-toggle__thumb { left: 28px; }

components.name: Hero Numeral Input
components.description: Signature component: the weight-entry field in the Log Weight sheet. No visible field chrome, just a giant editable numeral.
components.css: .ds-hero-input { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-hero-input__field { font-size: 60px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--color-brand-600, #1e3a8a); width: 192px; text-align: center; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; } .ds-hero-input__unit { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--theme-text-muted, #94a3b8); }

narrative.overview: Pivot reads like a discreet, precise health companion, never a hospital dashboard and never a leaderboard. One instrument-blue accent (#1e40af) carries every action and every moment that matters; everything else recedes into a slate neutral scale that is calm at rest and only ever raises its voice for a genuine warning (amber) or a destructive action (red). The interface is confident about hierarchy — a single giant, 900-weight numeral commands each screen — but restrained about ornament: flat white cards, soft single-direction shadows, and generous rounded corners instead of borders, gradients, or texture. The density is mobile-first and unapologetically single-column: every surface is built inside a fixed, phone-width frame (max 448px) with a bottom tab bar and a floating action button, even when viewed on desktop. Motion is physical rather than decorative — spring-damped sheets, active:scale-95 presses — which reinforces the 'instrument you hold' feeling rather than a 'page you browse.' Data visualization (the trend chart) is intentionally the quietest element on the Dashboard: a thin, low-opacity area fill with no gridlines beyond a faint horizontal rule, so the number above it stays the hero. Confirmed anti-reference: gamified fitness apps. Pivot already celebrates streaks and milestones, but never with badges, leaderboards, confetti, or streak-shaming language — celebration stays inside the same calm, single-accent vocabulary as everything else.
keyCharacteristics: One true accent hue (instrument blue); every other color is neutral or reserved for state (success/warning/danger)
A single 900-weight 'black' numeral or word per moment of commitment — brand mark, hero reading, primary action
Tiny, bold, uppercase, wide-tracked 'eyebrow' labels used everywhere instead of visible section chrome
Flat cards with soft shadows and no borders-as-decoration; shadow weight itself signals importance
Mobile-app shell (fixed phone frame, bottom nav, floating action button) regardless of viewport
Physical motion: spring sheets, scale-press feedback, no gratuitous decorative animation

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent hue in this system. A second 'brand' color is never introduced; new emphasis is expressed through the blue ramp's weight (50→900), not a new hue.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Light mode and dark mode are the same neutral (slate) ramp, just read in opposite directions. A new neutral token must define both ends of its own mirror; never hand-pick an unrelated dark-mode color.

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and danger colors appear only attached to a real system state — never as page decoration, never to differentiate content that isn't actually in that state.

rules.name: The Black Weight Rule
rules.body: Font-weight 900 is reserved for text that carries a decision or a commitment: the brand mark, a hero reading, a milestone numeral, or a primary action's own label. Never used for supporting copy, however short.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Any secondary or contextual label is set at 9-10px, bold, uppercase, and wide-tracked (letter-spacing 0.1em+). This is the system's substitute for visible chrome — the label itself does that job.

rules.name: The Escalation Rule
rules.body: Shadow depth tracks importance, not surface type. A card doesn't get heavier shadow because it's 'raised' — it gets heavier shadow because pressing it (or being it) is the most important thing on screen.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent hue. New emphasis is a weight or shade change on Instrument Blue, never a second brand color.
Do reserve font-weight 900 for numerals and words that represent a decision or commitment.
Do use the 9-10px bold-uppercase-wide-tracked label style for any new secondary/contextual text instead of inventing a new caption style.
Do let shadow weight communicate importance — a new primary action earns shadow-xl, not just a slightly darker shadow-sm.
Do register both light- and dark-mode values for any new neutral token, mirrored from the existing slate ramp, before using it anywhere.
Do keep celebratory/streak moments inside the existing calm vocabulary — a quiet amber banner with the eyebrow label style, not a badge, confetti, or a new visual language.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color, even for a 'special' feature — extend the existing blue ramp or use a state color instead.

Don't add a new destructive- or status-colored utility class without a matching --theme-* variable pair. Several existing classes (red-100, red-500, red-700, emerald-700) were used directly from Tailwind's default palette without a light/dark override and will render wrong in dark mode — don't repeat that gap.
Don't add gamification chrome (badges, leaderboards, confetti, 'you beat 87% of users' comparisons) — it's the system's explicit anti-reference.
Don't give a card heavier elevation than shadow-sm unless it is genuinely the primary action or the whole app shell.
Don't use a bordered/outlined input style — every field in this system is filled, with focus communicated by a ring, not a border-color change.
